blocks.text: Clayton homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Clayton, September 2026. Detached houses: 34 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 29% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 96 listed at month end and 20 sold in September, a sales ratio of 21% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 36 sold over 4 months against an average of 42.5 listed, about 4.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 10 sold. Condos and townhomes: 96 sold over 4 months against an average of 99.8 listed, about 4.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 29 sold.

faq.q: Is Clayton in Surrey or Langley?
faq.a: Surrey. The page covers the Clayton sub-area of Surrey's Cloverdale community; the City plans the ground as Clayton Heights, approximately 809 hectares from Fraser Highway to the ALR, bordered by the Township of Langley in the east — homes east of that municipal boundary are in the Township, not in Surrey Clayton.

faq.q: How did Clayton sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 34 active listings, 10 solds and a 29% sales ratio, and Condos & Townhomes recorded 96 listings, 20 solds and a 21% ratio — the highest ratios in the Cloverdale sub-area set that month; medians are published at community level only (Cloverdale detached $1,212,500; attached $740,000) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

Schools confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file in the Clayton / east Cloverdale part of Surrey include Katzie, Hazelgrove, Regent Road, Sunrise Ridge, Don Christian and Martha Currie elementaries, and Clayton Heights and École Salish secondaries — but catchments are address-based in SD36 and no Clayton locator result is on record, so check the exact address before relying on a school (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

The Surrey Langley SkyTrain project names Hillcrest-184 Street Station and Clayton Station (190 Street and Fraser Highway) among its eight stations, and TransLink states an anticipated in-service date of 2029 for the 16-kilometre Expo Line extension from King George Station to Langley City.
